title: R2 · colour trace
changes: Outline and holes now found by colour: every yellow pixel of the finger, and every dark blob inside it, instead of clicking points by eye.
All 25 holes use their photo position and size; the generated honeycomb is gone.
Every hole goes all the way through.
The blade thins from 12 mm at the knee to 5 mm at the tip.
review: Edges are jagged from photo noise; the photo's edges are smooth curves.
The blade slots run along the row; in the photo they slant about 35 degrees steeper, and they are bigger (about 2.6 mm long).
The tip is an angular cusp; the photo shows one rounded point.
The blade dot is too big (21 px against about 17 px).
One hole is too small, one small hole is missing, and three small holes should be ovals.
The placeholder pivot bore shows in the hook lip; the photo shows it solid.
The bar reads thin next to a 12 mm thickness; the thinning should be a bevel near the tip, not a long wedge.
